record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: ALOLAN_RATTATA (1 star) and ALOLAN_RATICATE (2 stars), the queued units.
record.summary: Single-target DEF reduction. The requested loss is a percentage of the target's CURRENT DEF at cast time: 20% at 1 star, 30% at 2, 40% at 3, 50% at 4+ (ALOLAN_RATTATA 20%, ALOLAN_RATICATE 30%), passed as a negative number to target.addDefense(defLoss, caster, 1, crit). addDefense then scales the (negative) amount by (1 + AP/100) and by critPower if the cast crit, rounds it, and applies the Big Eater Belt / Twist Band helpers of the TARGET: an enemy's reduction is not boosted by Big Eater Belt, but a Twist Band holder turns it into a gain of the same size. DEF cannot go below 0. No damage, no duration (the change stays for the fight).

declaredRaw.note: requested change as a share of the target's current DEF; with target DEF 10 the request is -2 (ALOLAN_RATTATA) / -3 (ALOLAN_RATICATE) before AP and rounding; the current def includes earlier buffs and debuffs

effects.scaling: addDefense: Math.round(value x (1 + AP/100) x (crit ? critPower : 1)) - AP (apBoost 1) and crit make the reduction larger; Math.round rounds halves toward +infinity, so a negative half such as -2.5 becomes -2; crit only with ABILITY_CRIT (canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: applied change to the target's combat DEF (permanent false): Big Eater Belt on the target does nothing here (the caster is an enemy and the value is negative); Twist Band on the target flips the sign (value x -1), turning the reduction into a gain; then def = max(0, def + value). Because the request is a share of the current DEF it shrinks as DEF falls, so repeated casts reduce DEF by decreasing amounts

starBehavior.note: percentage indexed by the caster's stars (pokemon.stars - 1), fallback 50; 40 and 50 are not reached by these units. maxPP 90 and range 1 for both.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No state is kept. Each cast recomputes from the target's current DEF, so reductions compound multiplicatively on what remains (before rounding). No modes.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: -20% (ALOLAN_RATTATA) / -30% (ALOLAN_RATICATE) of the target's current DEF. After addDefense: round(request x (1 + AP/100) [x critPower]) is the amount handed to the helpers; applied change = that amount (negative), unchanged by Big Eater Belt, sign-flipped by Twist Band, floored at DEF 0. The caster's own stats are not touched.
